comparison.objective: Place five polarized 5050 LEDs on circuit-board footprints with tweezers.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated 5 mm part pickup, polarity recognition, in-plane rotation, and unregistered precision placement.
comparison.success_condition: Each LED is flat, centered within 1 mm, and its cathode corner is within 10 degrees of the mark; tweezers return to cups and are released.
comparison.reason: Shares millimetre-scale tool handling, but tests free placement and polarity matching without mechanical registration, not coaxial contact, impact fracture, or fragment extraction.
